name: Algebraic Property Substitution via Matrix Square Sum
description: Replaced the determinant condition with the condition that the sum of all elements in the matrix square S^2 equals 12. Since the sum of elements in S^2 for a symmetric adjacency matrix algebraically simplifies to the sum of the squared degrees of the vertices, this perfectly isolates the 3-clique (degrees 2,2,2 -> sum of squares 12) while forcing the model to conceptually link matrix element sums to graph degrees rather than relying on memorized determinant properties.
